Part Name: M12 17P Male PCB Connector, non-shielded (shielded alt: MSAS-17PMMP-SF8001)
Notes: J2 — non-shielded M12A-17PMMP-SF8001 (PCB 180°), matching schematic, footprint, and parts currently in use. Previous link pointed to M12A-17PMMS-SF8001 (solder-cup variant), which does not fit the footprint. Link is a DigiKey exact-MPN search. Cost $14.56 is Electromaker's US list for this exact MPN; DigiKey DE lists €13.37, and DigiKey US prices the solder-cup sibling (M12A-17PMMS-SF8001) at $13.19 @1. Replace with actual purchase price. SHIELDED ALTERNATIVE: MSAS-17PMMP-SF8001 — DigiKey 1754-MSAS-17PMMP-SF8001-ND (Amphenol direct, 4-wk lead, price not shown). Also listed by marketplace seller JRH at ~$134.59/ea — avoid that listing. MSAS needs a shield pad added to the footprint. With the non-shielded body, J2 pin 18 has no physical pin, so R3/C1 currently connect to nothing.

J4 — Ethernet. DigiKey 664-RJHSE3085-ND. Unshielded vertical RJ45 with integrated green LEDs; LED pins are unconnected on this board. Cost $1.97 carried over from previous entry; price basis not re-verified at DigiKey.
J3 — 12–24V power input (pin 1 VIN, pin 6 GND). Cost $0.96 carried over from previous entry; price basis not re-verified at DigiKey.
Not used on X4A (qty 0). Superseded by APA1606SURCK side-mount LED (D1). Kept for reference.

C2, C5 — input/output decoupling. Row previously '1uF 0603 Decoupling Cap'; no 1µF exists in the schematic. Samsung CL10B104KB8NNNC, DigiKey 1276-1000-1-ND (cut tape). $0.10 @1. DigiKey stock showed conflicting values at check; any 100nF 50V X7R 0603 is a drop-in equivalent.

R1 — LED series resistor. Changed from 2.0k; 2.0k dissipates 242mW at 24V and exceeds the 0603 100mW rating. 6.8k gives 3.2mA/71mW at 24V, 1.5mA at 12V. Yageo RC0603FR-076K8L, DigiKey 311-6.80KHRCT-ND, $0.10 @1.
D1 — power indicator on VOUT. Cost updated $0.126 → $0.26: $0.126 was DigiKey's qty-100 break; BoM now prices at qty 1. Breaks: $0.26 @1, $0.18 @10, $0.1264 @100. DigiKey 754-1054-1-ND.

C3 — output bulk capacitor. 50V rating required for 24V operation (X7R DC-bias derating on a 25V part would gut the effective capacitance). TDK C3216X7R1H106K160AC, DigiKey 445-181601-1-ND, $0.89 @1. 10µF/50V/1206 stock is volatile; alternate Samsung CL31B106KBHNNNE ($0.42 @1, showed 0 stock at check).

U2 — 60V eFuse. Schematic value reads 'TPS26600PWP'; orderable part is TPS26600PWPR (DigiKey cut tape 296-47292-1-ND). Qty-1 price seen at $3.79–$4.02 across DigiKey page snapshots; $4.02 used. Stock status conflicted between snapshots — confirm at order.

R5 — eFuse ILIM. Sets breaker threshold ≈ 12/6.34 = 1.89A (MODE open). 1% required since it directly sets the current limit. Yageo RC0603FR-076K34L, $0.10 @1 (RC0603FR family pricing). Link is a DigiKey exact-MPN search.
R6 — eFuse FLT pull-up to VIN (2.4mA/58mW when asserted at 24V). Yageo RC0603FR-0710KL, $0.10 @1 (RC0603FR family pricing). Link is a DigiKey exact-MPN search.
U1 — 4-channel ESD protection on the Ethernet pairs. DigiKey 296-39346-1-ND (cut tape). $1.06 @1.

C4 — eFuse dVdT timing capacitor (~2.5ms ramp at 12V). Must be C0G/NP0: X7R would drift the turn-on ramp with bias and temperature. Murata GRM1885C1H103JA01D, 10nF ±5% 50V. $0.13 @1, $0.0425 @100. Alternate Yageo CC0603JRNPO9BN103 (DigiKey 311-3960-1-ND).
R4 — eFuse SHDN pull-up to VIN. Yageo RC0603FR-07100KL, $0.10 @1 (RC0603FR family pricing). Link is a DigiKey exact-MPN search.

D2 — output TVS. Changed from SMAJ15A, which breaks down at 16.7V and cannot survive a 24V rail. 28V standoff, 31.1V breakdown min, 45.4V clamp. Clamp is above the D1R 32V limit, so eFuse OVP must protect the LiDAR, not this part. DigiKey SMAJ28ALFCT-ND (cut tape).

R3 — cable shield bleed resistor. Changed from 2.0k, which was neither a hard chassis bond nor a proper bleed. Pairs with C1 as 1M || 10nF. Yageo RC0603FR-071ML, $0.10 @1 (RC0603FR family pricing). Link is a DigiKey exact-MPN search.

C1 — shield bond capacitor, previously unvalued. Footprint changed 0603 to 1206 because 10nF at 1kV is not available in 0603, and a low-voltage part failing short would bond shield to GND and create the ground loop the network exists to prevent. Yageo CC1206KKX7RCBB103, 10nF ±10% 1kV X7R, DigiKey 311-1500-1-ND. $0.71 @1, $0.2958 @100. 10,151 in stock at check.
